name: Level_1 - Task_6
description: Construct a bulk conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Copper (Cu) with a lattice parameter a = 3.615 Å, and expand it into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell. Construct a separate bulk conventional FCC unit cell of Nickel (Ni) with a lattice parameter a = 3.52 Å. Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator and attach it to both structures. Perform a geometry optimization (e.g., using BFGS) on both the pure Cu supercell and the pure Ni unit cell until the maximum atomic force is below 0.00005 eV/Å, and calculate their respective energies per atom. Next, identify the Cu atom closest to the geometric center of the Cu supercell and replace it with a Ni atom. Relax this defective supercell using the same optimization criteria. Calculate the impurity substitution energy using E_sub = E_defected - E_pure_Cu + E_Cu_bulk_per_atom - E_Ni_bulk_per_atom, where E_defected is the relaxed total energy of the Ni-substituted Cu supercell, E_pure_Cu is the relaxed total energy of the pure Cu 3 × 3 × 3 supercell, and E_Cu_bulk_per_atom and E_Ni_bulk_per_atom are the relaxed energies per atom of the corresponding bulk Cu and Ni unit cells. Return the impurity substitution energy as a floating-point value in eV units. USE ASE FOR THIS SIMULATION, DO NOT USE LAMMPS.
